<issue>
[BUG] Cognito IDP ListUserPoolClients Response doesn't match spec
## Service

Cognito IDP

## AWS API Action

ListUserPoolClients

## Expected behavior

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito-user-identity-pools/latest/APIReference/API_ListUserPoolClients.html
Response should include only ClientId, ClientName and UserPoolId

## Actual behavior

It includes all properties in the response, including ClientSecret, GenerateSecret, AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient, AllowedOAuthFlows, AllowedOAuthScopes, CreationDate and LastModifiedDate

## Reproduction

```bash
# Minimal AWS CLI or SDK snippet that triggers the issue
aws  --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 list-user-pool-clients --user-pool-id <user-pool-id>
```


## Environment

- Floci version / image tag: latest
- Java SDK version (if applicable): --
- How you're running Floci (Docker / native / `mvn quarkus:dev`): --

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the Cognito IDP ListUserPoolClients handler (grep -ri ListUserPoolClients src/main). Report the handler code in the controller/handler and how the response JSON is built (file paths, line numbers, and the code verbatim), plus the helper that converts a client to a node (e.g. userPoolClientToNode).

There is no userPoolClientToNode; the helper is named clientToNode. The handler ignores pagination inputs (MaxResults/NextToken) and emits no NextToken. Nothing was modified.","findings":["Dispatch: src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/cognito/CognitoJsonHandler.java:44 `case \"ListUserPoolClients\" -> handleListUserPoolClients(request);`","Handler at CognitoJsonHandler.java:151-157: `private Response handleListUserPoolClients(JsonNode request) { List<UserPoolClient> clients = service.listUserPoolClients(request.path(\"UserPoolId\").asText()); ObjectNode response = objectMapper.createObjectNode(); ArrayNode items = response.putArray(\"UserPoolClients\"); clients.forEach(c -> items.add(clientToNode(c))); return Response.ok(response).build(); }`","Response JSON: a root ObjectNode with a single key \"UserPoolClients\" holding an ArrayNode of client nodes; no NextToken or pagination fields are set.","Service: CognitoService.java:196-198 `public List<UserPoolClient> listUserPoolClients(String userPoolId) { return clientStore.scan(k -> clientStore.get(k).map(c -> c.getUserPoolId().equals(userPoolId)).orElse(false)); }` filters the client store by UserPoolId.","Helper: there is no 'userPoolClientToNode'. The converter is `clientToNode` at CognitoJsonHandler.java:468-485, returning an ObjectNode with keys ClientId, UserPoolId, ClientName, ClientSecret (only if non-null), GenerateSecret, AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient, AllowedOAuthFlows (array), AllowedOAuthScopes (array), CreationDate, LastModifiedDate.","clientToNode is also used by handleCreateUserPoolClient (line 137) and handleDescribeUserPoolClient (line 147).","A grep for ListUserPoolClients in src/main also matches src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/core/common/AwsQueryController.java (a string list containing \"ListUserPoolClients\"), which is not part of the JSON handler path."],"confidence":0.85}

content.text:
ListUserPoolClients now returns only `ClientId`, `UserPoolId` and `ClientName` for each client, as the AWS spec says. I haven't compiled it or run any tests.

The change is in `handleListUserPoolClients` in `CognitoJsonHandler.java`. It builds each list entry with those three fields instead of calling `clientToNode`. `CreateUserPoolClient` and `DescribeUserPoolClient` still use `clientToNode`, so they return the full set of properties, which is correct for those calls.

I didn't add pagination. The handler still ignores `MaxResults` and `NextToken` and never returns a `NextToken`.
